# git2py

> Mapping git operation to a dict-like Data Object Layer


## Pages in this subsection

- [git2py](git2py.html.md): The intent of this package was to provide a simple, high-level interface to git.
- [git2py.gitlab_utils](git2py.gitlab_utils.html.md): Stores to talk to gitlab, using requests.
- [git2py.migration](git2py.migration.html.md): Migrate git repositories between GitHub and GitLab.
